blocks.text: Jo amines paani mein ghul jati hain woh ammonia ki tarah halke alkaline solutions banati hain, kyunke yeh paani (solvent) se thora sa (partially) react kar ke OH⁻ ions banati hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne ethanamine wali equation ke saath pKb = 4.75 likha hai; yeh ammonia ki value hai. Kitab ke apne Table 24.1 mein ethanamine ka pKb = 3.29 (Kb = 5.1 × 10⁻⁴) hai, jo yahan likha gaya hai.

blocks.text_alt: C₆H₅–NH₂ (phenylamine) + H₂O → C₆H₅–NH₃⁺ (phenyl ammonium ion) + OH⁻   (pKb = 9.38)

blocks.text: Amine ki basicity (base hone ki taqat) is par depend karti hai ke nitrogen atom ka lone pair kitni aasani se mil sakta hai. Paani ke saath reactions se amines aur ammonia ki pKb values maloom hoti hain. Kb jitna bara (ya pKb jitna chhota), base utna taqatwar. Nitrogen se jure electron dene wale (electron-donating) alkyl groups basicity barhate hain, aur electron kheenchne wale (electron-withdrawing) groups ghatate hain. Aam taur par jo compound zyada basic ho woh zyada taqatwar nucleophile bhi hota hai. Is se hum yeh nateeja nikalte hain:

items: Ethanamine ammonia aur methanamine (primary amine) se taqatwar base hai. Isi tarah alkyl amines ammonia se taqatwar bases hain.

Ammonia phenylamine jaisi aromatic amines se taqatwar base hai. Wajah: phenylamine mein nitrogen ka lone pair benzene ring par phail (delocalise ho) jata hai, jaisa Figure 24.1 mein hai. Nitrogen atom planar (hamwar) hai aur us ka lone pair p orbital mein hai, jo benzene ring ke delocalised π electrons se overlap karta hai. Is liye lone pair proton lene ke liye kam milta hai.

blocks.alt: Perspective mein benzene ring, jis ke oopar aur neeche delocalised pi electrons ke do hare halqe hain. Ring N atom se juri hai jis ke do hare p-orbital lobes (aik oopar, aik neeche) aur do H atoms hain (aik peeche, aik aage). Teer lobes se ring ke badalon ki taraf ishara karte hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 24.1: Phenylamine mein nitrogen ke lone pair ki delocalisation (kitab ki Figure 24.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Hare halqe benzene ke delocalised π electrons ke badal (clouds) hain, aik ring ke oopar aur aik neeche. Nitrogen ka lone pair aik p orbital mein hai (oopar neeche do hare lobes). Teer dikhate hain ke yeh p orbital ring ke π badal se overlap karta hai. Is liye lone pair ring par phail jata hai aur proton lene ke liye kam milta hai: phenylamine ammonia se kamzor base hai.

Base hone ki wajah se ammonia aur ethanamine acid se react kar ke salt (namak) banate hain. Is reaction mein nitrogen atom apna electron pair proton ko de kar dative bond banata hai, aur salt banta hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Machhli ki buri boo N,N-dimethylmethanamine (trimethylamine) ki wajah se hoti hai. Machhli par lemon ka ras chhirakne se us ka acid (citric acid) amine se react kar ke salt bana deta hai, is liye boo kam ho jati hai. Sirke (vinegar) mein machhli rakhne se bhi yahi hota hai. (Kitab ne naam ‘dimethylmathanamine’ chhapa hai; sahi spelling dimethylmethanamine hai.)

blocks.prompt: Amines ke paani wale solutions alkaline kyun hote hain?
blocks.explanation: Nitrogen ka lone pair paani se proton (H⁺) leta hai aur OH⁻ ions bante hain: RNH₂ + H₂O ⇌ RNH₃⁺ + OH⁻.

items: Amines nitrogen ke lone pair par H⁺ leti hain, is liye halke alkaline solutions banati hain.
Amines acids se salts banati hain, maslan CH₃CH₂NH₃⁺Cl⁻.
